text.p: Papua New Guinean gold miner Highlands Gold Ltd said on Thursday that talks with potential underwriters of a Highlands restructuring were continuing.
However, it was unlikely that a proposal would be completed before the closing of Placer Dome Inc's 75 cents per share offer on January 18.
Highland said that as Placer might be in a position to control Highlands after its offer closed, any restructuring would necessitate Placer's co-operation.
Directors of Highlands said they continued to recommend that shareholders reject Placer's offer as it undervalued Highlands and a restructuring would be in the best interests of all shareholders.

Highlands said Placer's indicated objective was to acquire all of Highland's intereste in the Porgera gold mine in Papua New Guinea, and in the event that it did not compulsorily acquire all outstanding shares, a further proposal may be
By 3.25 p.m. (0325 GMT), Highlands shares were one cent lower at 74 cents on turnover of 948,890 shares.
